description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that serves as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility, providing static methods for logging at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It manages a linked list of LogNode objects for handling log data and offers convenience methods for different log priorities.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods to facilitate logging, acting as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility and supporting chaining via LogNode objects.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode that will receive log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message to the configured LogNode chain with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, optionally with an exception.
